_comment: Universal, extensible capability vocabulary (v2). Keys are data, not Lean code. Values are integers in the canonical unit named here; the data layer converts them exactly to SI rationals with dimensions for Lean. 'better' says which direction is favourable. 'min'-shaped keys are bounds where lower is better.

magnetic_field.max.description: Maximum documented magnetic field at the sample

cooldown_time.max.description: Documented time to reach base temperature

optical_access.description: Optical access to the sample is installed

optical.objective_working_distance.min.description: Minimum objective working distance the window geometry requires

electrical.dc_lines.description: Number of DC wiring lines to the sample

electrical.coax_lines.description: Number of coaxial / RF lines to the sample

electrical.channels.description: Number of measurement channels of the installed module

electrical.current.range.description: Excitation current range of the installed module

electrical.resistance.range.description: Resistance measurement range of the installed module

electrical.sample_connections.description: Electrical connections to the sample are installed

module.acms.description: AC susceptibility / DC magnetometry option installed

module.magnetic_shielding.description: Magnetic shielding of the sample space installed

sample.vsm.diameter.max.description: Maximum sample/holder diameter accepted by an installed VSM coil set (module-specific; does not limit other modules)

sample.heat_capacity.width.max.description: Maximum sample width on an installed heat-capacity platform (module-specific)

sample.heat_capacity.length.max.description: Maximum sample length on an installed heat-capacity platform (module-specific)

experimental_space.height.description: Height of the experimental space below the coldest plate

temperature.peltier_delta.max.description: Extra cooling of the Peltier quick-freeze station

cooldown_time.sample_exchange.description: Documented time to cool a newly loaded sample (lower is better)

magnetic_field.uniformity.description: Documented field inhomogeneity over the stated volume (lower is better)

temperature.stability.relative.description: Documented relative temperature stability (lower is better)

system_startup_time.max.description: Documented time from room temperature to operation (lower is better)

temperature.gradient.description: Documented temperature gradient across the sample position (lower is better)

thermal.contact_resistance.description: Thermal contact resistance of the sample mount (lower is better)

thermal_cycles.max.description: Documented number of thermal cycles the mount/sample tolerates

sample.orientation.description: Sample orientations supported (e.g. horizontal, vertical, rotatable)

sample.vsm.length.max.description: Recommended maximum sample length for the installed VSM (module-specific)

mechanical.resonance.min_frequency.description: Lowest documented mechanical resonance of the sample stage

mechanical.stress.max.description: Allowed mechanical stress on the sample mount

vibration.frequency.description: Frequency band of the documented vibration

magnetic_field.direction.description: Magnetic field directions available (longitudinal, transverse, vector)

electrical.current.max.description: Maximum excitation current of the installed electrical module

electrical.noise_rms.description: Documented RMS voltage noise over a stated bandwidth (lower is better)

rf.power.max.description: Maximum RF/microwave power deliverable to the sample

gas.compatible.description: Gases the sample space may be filled or purged with

purge.gas.description: Sample chamber can be purged with gas (dry gas purge against condensation)

cryogen.dewar_volume.description: Volume of the cryogen dewar supplied

optical.transmission_range.description: Wavelength range transmitted by the optical window

optical.f_number.description: Documented f-number of the optical access (lower = wider cone)

optical.numerical_aperture.description: Documented numerical aperture of the optical access

measurement.bandwidth.description: Measurement bandwidth of the installed module

flow.mach.range.description: Documented controlled Mach-number interval in the aerodynamic test section

temperature.cold_boundary.range.description: Controlled cold-side boundary temperature of a guarded insulation calorimeter

temperature.warm_boundary.range.description: Controlled warm-side boundary temperature of a guarded insulation calorimeter

module.aerodynamic_force_pressure_test.description: Documented installed function: aerodynamic force pressure test

module.liquid_hydrogen_handling.description: Documented installed function: liquid hydrogen handling

module.propellant_acquisition_transfer.description: Documented installed function: propellant acquisition transfer

module.guarded_heat_flow_calorimetry.description: Documented installed function: guarded heat flow calorimetry

temperature.optical_bench.range.description: Documented optical-bench operating temperature, distinct from detector sample or radiation shroud

module.mid_ir_detector_characterization.description: Documented installed function: mid ir detector characterization

module.internal_offner_relay.description: Documented installed function: internal offner relay

module.cryogenic_mirror_interferometry.description: Documented installed function: cryogenic mirror interferometry

temperature.gradient.max.description: Maximum spatial temperature gradient/difference across the test specimen; lower is better

module.integrated_telescope_optical_test.description: Documented installed function: integrated telescope optical test

module.cryogenic_tensile_test.description: Documented installed function: cryogenic tensile test

module.cryogenic_fatigue_test.description: Documented installed function: cryogenic fatigue test

mechanical.cycling_frequency.max.description: Documented maximum cyclic loading frequency of the mechanical test frame

module.cryogenic_gas_permeation.description: Documented installed function: cryogenic gas permeation

rf.frequency.range.description: Documented measurement frequency interval or explicitly reported operating point of the installed RF fixture

module.far_ir_detector_photometry.description: Documented installed function: far ir detector photometry

module.cold_dark_shutter.description: Documented installed function: cold dark shutter

module.micro_jt_cooling.description: Documented installed function: micro jt cooling

module.stable_thz_detector_operation.description: Documented installed function: stable thz detector operation

module.cryogenic_microwave_transmission.description: Documented installed function: cryogenic microwave transmission

module.full_magnet_cold_qualification.description: Documented installed function: full magnet cold qualification

module.high_current_conductor_test.description: Documented installed function: high current conductor test

module.cryopump_gas_injection_test.description: Documented installed function: cryopump gas injection test

module.srf_cavity_rf_test.description: Documented installed function: srf cavity rf test

module.dual_phase_argon_charge_light.description: Documented installed function: dual phase argon charge light

module.teo2_bolometer_calorimetry.description: Documented installed function: teo2 bolometer calorimetry

module.neutron_powder_diffraction.description: Documented installed function: neutron powder diffraction

module.nitrogen_physisorption_bet.description: Documented installed function: nitrogen physisorption bet

process.controlled_rate_freezing.description: Programmed, controlled-rate biological sample freezing is documented.

process.cryogenic_milling.description: Mechanical sample comminution with documented cryogenic cooling.

process.freeze_drying.description: Vacuum freeze drying of pre-frozen bulk samples (not merely a cold condenser).

process.dsc.description: Differential scanning calorimetry with a heat-flow sensor and reference is available.

process.deep_cryogenic_treatment.description: Controlled sub-zero treatment of metal parts is documented.

process.vitrification.description: The documented carrier/protocol supports rapid cryoprotectant-assisted vitrification.

process.ln2_immersion.description: Direct liquid-nitrogen immersion of the documented sample carrier.

process.circulating_bath.description: Refrigerated circulating liquid bath, including its liquid work area.

process.temperature_cycling.description: A chamber with programmable temperature cycling is documented.

module.dewpoint_control.description: The complete humidified/dry gas mixing and dew-point measurement chain is installed.

module.complex_resistivity.description: A complex-resistivity measurement chain and sample electrodes are installed.

module.sample_thermometry.description: Independent sample thermocouple and logger are installed.

module.eight_well_freezing_block.description: The validated thermal-contact aluminum block for eight-well strips is installed.

module.dynamic_nitrogen_purge.description: Dynamic nitrogen purge of the calorimeter is documented.

process.cryogenic_preconcentration.description: Cryogenic trapping and focusing for gas analysis is documented.

module.gc_ms.description: An interfaced gas chromatograph and mass-selective detector are documented.

temperature.cooling_rate.range.description: Documented controlled cooling-rate magnitudes; do not substitute heating rates.

milling.frequency.range.description: Documented grinding-jar vibration frequency, not electrical line frequency.

milling.duration.max.description: Documented programmable maximum milling duration (not a guarantee against sample warming).

milling.jar_volume.description: Nominal volume of the documented grinding jar.

condenser.temperature.min.description: Lowest documented freeze-dryer collector/condenser temperature; never substitute for shelf/sample temperature.

trap.precool.temperature.description: Lowest documented cold-focusing-trap precool setting for the selected installed method.

trap.inject.temperature.description: Documented hot desorption/injection trap setpoint for the selected method.

dwell.duration.max.description: Maximum documented hold duration for the specified thermal process.

carrier.oocyte.capacity.description: Maximum recommended number of oocytes on the documented vitrification carrier.

process.nerve_cryoneurolysis.description: Documented peripheral-nerve freezing with the specified surgical cryoprobe.

probe.temperature.range.description: Documented cryoprobe operating temperature envelope,distinct from tissue temperature and console ambient range.

probe.freeze_duration.range.description: Conservatively documented supported freeze durations; a single-point interval records one established timer setting.

module.direct_visualization.description: Documented installed direct-visualization equipment for the selected procedure; never inferred from a console specification.

module.boiloff_calorimetry.description: Installed steady-state liquid-cryogen boiloff calorimetry measurement apparatus

module.volumetric_hydrogen_sorption.description: Installed volumetric hydrogen dosing and adsorption-isotherm measurement system

module.cryogenic_tensile.description: Installed cryogenic specimen grips, mechanical load frame and tensile measurement apparatus

module.acoustic_gas_thermometry.description: Installed acoustic resonator, transducers and readout for primary gas thermometry

module.resistance_thermometry_bridge.description: Installed resistance-thermometer measurement bridge in the documented configuration

module.programmable_josephson_voltage.description: Installed programmable Josephson junction array and microwave/bias electronics for voltage metrology

module.electrical_substitution_radiometr.description: Installed absorbing cavity, electrical heater, thermometry and optical-power substitution readout

module.snspd_detection.description: Installed superconducting nanowire single-photon detector and operating bias/readout electronics

module.photon_timing.description: Installed time-correlated photon counting or time-tagging instrument

module.calibrated_photon_flux.description: Installed calibrated optical power measurement and attenuation path for detector characterization

module.quantum_dot_excitation.description: Installed pulsed optical excitation and collection apparatus for a quantum-dot emitter

module.hbt_correlation.description: Installed two-detector beam-splitter correlation apparatus for second-order photon autocorrelation

module.optical_resonance_interrogation.description: Installed laser frequency scanning and transmission readout of a cryogenic optical resonator

module.semiconductor_parameter_analyzer.description: Installed source/measure analyzer for semiconductor DC characteristics

module.capacitance_transient_spectroscop.description: Installed capacitance-transient measurement and trap-filling electronics for DLTS

module.hall_measurement.description: Installed Hall sourcing, voltage measurement, switching and analysis instrumentation

module.liquid_nitrogen_bath.description: Documented flooded liquid-nitrogen sample bath in this configuration

module.electrical_probing.description: Cryogenic instrument supports contacting electronic samples with electrical probe arms

pressure.operating.range.description: Documented pressure interval used by the sample/resonator gas handling system

electrical.reference_voltage.max.description: Largest magnitude reference voltage produced by a documented voltage standard

chamber.volume.description: Usable internal volume of the sample/storage/test space (freezer cabinet, controlled-rate-freezer chamber, environmental/thermal-vacuum chamber, freeze-dryer product chamber, archive freezer). Example: Planer Kryo 560-16 'Chamber volume 16 litres'.

storage.capacity.vials_2ml.description: Documented maximum number of 1.2/2.0 mL cryovials held with the standard inventory system (LN2 freezers, dewars, CRFs, freezers when stated in vials). Example: MVE HEco 815P-190 '15,600'.

storage.capacity.straws_0_5ml.description: Documented maximum number of 0.5 mL (1/2 cc) straws (semen/embryo banking, IVF, livestock genetics). Example: MVE HE 800 C 'over 22,000 1/2cc straws'.

holding_time.static.description: Static holding time: how long one cryogen charge keeps the storage/sample space at its rated temperature without refill or external power (LN2 dewars, vapour freezers, dry shippers, LHe cryostats). Days convert exactly (x24). Example: MVE dry shipper 'STATIC HOLD TIME ... 18 DAYS'.

temperature.shroud.range.description: Temperature range of the thermal shroud/cold wall of a thermal-vacuum or space-simulation chamber (radiative environment); the platen/test-article range stays in temperature.range. Example: 'Shroud temperature control range: -180 to +150 C'.

temperature.condenser.min.description: Lowest documented temperature of the freeze-dryer ice condenser / cold trap (aqueous -50 C vs solvent/low-collapse -80 to -85 C). Example: Christ Epsilon 2-4 condenser minimum -85 C.

condenser.ice_capacity.description: Documented maximum ice load of the freeze-dryer condenser before defrost, in kg; capacities printed in litres are a different dimension and must not be converted.

cooling_power.at_77000mK.description: Documented cooling power at 77 K (tactical IR Stirling coolers, HTS cable/SFCL coolers, reliquefiers); ambient condition kept in evidence. Example: Ricor K508 '550mW@77K@71C'.

cooling_power.at_80000mK.description: Documented cooling power at 80 K, the standard rating point of space and long-life pulse-tube/Stirling coolers. Example: NICMOS cryocooler '7 W at 80 K'.

pressure.max_working.description: Maximum allowable working pressure of the sample vessel/chamber/flow loop (cryogenic test vessels, supercritical-He loops, high-pressure freezers 2100 bar, hydrate cells, LH2/LNG tanks). bar converts exactly; psi only as a bound rounded down with the printed value in the quote.

cryogen.flow_rate.max.description: Maximum liquid-cryogen flow delivered to the process or meter under test (cryogenic machining, LN2 tunnel freezers, LNG/LN2 flow calibration, transfer systems); gas flow stays in gas.flow_rate.max. m3/h converts exactly only if divisible by 3.

electrical.current_leads.max.description: Maximum transport current of installed current leads to the sample (HTS tape/cable Ic tests, magnet and fusion conductor tests); distinct from electrical.current.max of a measurement module. Example: SPARC TFMC '50 kA capacity ... current leads'.

humidity.range.description: Controllable relative-humidity range of the sample chamber (cryo-EM plunge freezers, climatic/damp-heat chambers, cloud chambers). Example: Vitrobot SOP 'Humidity 100%, Temperature 4 C - 22 C'.
